body:
# Release Notes - v1.16.0 ## New Features & Enhancements ### Tallyhall - Automatic cost center mapping for NetSuite and Xero Exports to NetSuite and Xero now map your cost centers to the matching departments, classes, or tracking categories automatically, using a mapping you review once per entity. A blank or unmapped cost center no longer breaks the whole export: those lines are held back and listed so you can fix them in one place, and the rest of the export goes through. ### Tallyhall - Spend anomaly detection at department and entity level Unusual spend is now flagged at the department and entity level, not only per employee. A sudden jump in one team's travel spend shows up as a single alert with the employees and merchants driving it, measured against that team's own last 90 days. ### Tallyhall - 13 new receipt matching rules with automatic attach Receipts sitting in the inbox are now matched to card transactions automatically using 13 new rules covering amount, merchant name variants, and date windows. Confident matches attach on their own; the rest are suggested to the employee once a day instead of one notification per receipt. ### Tallyhall - Clearer card account states Card accounts now show whether they are Active, Need re-linking, Paused, or Closed, with the reason in plain language and a button to fix it. This view is flag-gated and is being enabled company by company over the next few weeks while support teams are trained on it. ### Tallyhall Mobile - Submit mileage from your trip history, with saved routes Tallyhall Mobile can now create a mileage claim from a trip in your phone's location history, or from a saved route such as home to client site. The distance is calculated for you and the claim is ready to submit in two taps. ## Fixes ### Scheduled exports no longer silently skipped Scheduled exports that fell on the first day of a month with a payroll cutoff were skipped without any error. They now run on time and, if an export cannot run, the admin gets an email with the reason. ### Cancelled cards no longer shown as Active Cards cancelled at the issuer kept showing as Active in Tallyhall because the old file import never received a cancellation. Card status now comes from the issuer directly. ### Deactivated employees no longer offered as approvers The approver picker listed employees who had been deactivated, so new approval chains could be built around someone who had left. They are now hidden from the picker. ### Per diem claims now show the correct country rate Per diem claims for trips abroad used the home country rate. The destination country rate is now applied, and the claim shows which rate was used. ### Anomaly alert details - missing employee names and misleading reason text Some anomaly alerts were missing the employee name or described the cause as "unknown" when the merchant was the clear driver. Alert details now always include the employee and the top merchants. ### UI & Experience Improvements Tooltips are now consistent across the app and appear on every truncated value. The Trend chart legend no longer overlaps on small screens, and the mobile menu no longer closes when you scroll. Empty states on Reports and Cards now explain what to do next instead of showing a blank table. ## Technical details
Accounting sync - NetSuite and Xero cost center mapping + "View mapping" surface - The sync now maps Tallyhall cost centers to NetSuite departments and classes, and to Xero tracking categories, using a saved mapping table per entity. - Unmapped cost centers no longer fail the whole export: the affected lines are held back and listed in a new **View mapping** panel with a one-click fix. - Mapping changes are versioned so an export can always be re-run with the mapping it originally used. - Covered by fixture-driven tests for both providers, including blank cost centers and archived departments.
Spend anomaly detection at department and entity level - Anomaly scoring now runs on department and entity rollups in addition to individual employees, using a 90-day baseline per rollup. - Alerts are grouped so one unusual week at the department level produces one alert, not one per employee. - Thresholds are configurable per entity in Settings, with sensible defaults for new accounts.
Receipt matching rules - matcher, rules engine, and notifier - Thirteen new rules match unattached receipts in the inbox to card transactions by amount, merchant, and date window. - Matches above the confidence threshold attach automatically; the rest go to the employee as a suggestion. - The notifier batches suggestions into one message per employee per day.
Card account status UI (web + mobile) - Card accounts show one of four states: Active, Needs re-link, Paused, or Closed, with the reason underneath. - The new status panel is flag-gated per company while support teams are trained on it. - Mobile shows the same states in the Cards tab.
Approvals - drop stale status pre-check - The approval endpoint no longer re-reads a cached status before deciding, which was the source of rare double approvals; the database row lock is now the single check.
Card feed - dedicated Amex connector replaces the generic file import - A dedicated connector reads Amex transactions through the issuer API, so cancelled cards stop appearing as Active and posting dates are exact.
Inactive employees filtered from the approver picker (`applyActiveOnly`) - The approver picker hides deactivated employees and anyone without approval rights, so approval chains can no longer be built around someone who has left.
App-wide tooltip sweep + Trend / Policy / Mobile menu fixes - Consistent tooltip delay and placement across the app; truncated values now always have a tooltip. - Fixes the Trend chart legend overlapping on small screens and the mobile menu closing on scroll.
Drop legacy `card_account_permissions` table (ledger) - The table was replaced by per-role permissions in #812 and has had no reads since; this release removes it (#907).
Per diem rates - country lookup + rate table refresh (ledger + web) - Per diem claims look up the destination country's rate from a rate table refreshed monthly; companies can override any rate with a CSV upload (#915).
